# sca import

[← Command reference](../commands.md)

`<sca_options>` are the [global options](../commands.md#global-options).

```text
The import command help

Import command is used for importing certificate documents.
all the files present in the transfer_files_folder with tgz file extension
are imported. those files are expected to be the products of the sca export
command.
```

**Syntax**

```text
sca [<sca_options>] import [<import_options>]

import_options:

  -h, --help      - print this help
```
